summary: Comprehensive testing of JasprChain L1 blockchain persistence and unbonding features. All 53 backend API tests passed (100%). New features: LMDB persistence layer for blocks/state, 14-day unbonding period for unstaking. Frontend updated to display unbonding entries.
passed_tests: - latest_height tracked and increases with new blocks
- Block production continues in real-time (2s block time)
- Unstake creates unbonding entry (not immediate return)
- Unstake message shows unlock date (14 days from now)
- Unbonding entries include remaining_days and is_claimable
- Staking info includes unbonding section with total_unbonding and claimable
- Multiple unstakes create multiple unbonding entries
- Health endpoint returns chain_id=1, status=healthy, network=testnet
- Network stats shows 4 validators, TPS, finality metrics
- Tokenomics returns correct litepaper values (1B JASPR, 52% community, etc.)
- Validators endpoint returns 4 validators with APY
- Wallet creation returns MPC wallet with 10,000 JASPR
- Dashboard loads with JASPR branding, TESTNET badge
- Block height updates in real-time (persistence working)
- Staking page shows 4 validators with APY (9.2-9.7%)
- Validator selection shows stake form with estimated APY
- Unbonding section added to staking page (displays when entries exist)
critical_code_review_comments: LMDB persistence layer correctly implemented in /app/backend/jasprchain/storage/persistence.py
Blocks, state, and unbonding entries properly persisted to /app/data/jasprchain
Unbonding entries include remaining_days and is_claimable fields
Claim endpoint correctly validates unbonding period completion
Frontend StakingPage updated to display unbonding entries with remaining days
seed_data_creation: Test wallets created during testing for staking/unbonding flow verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: JasprChain L1 blockchain now has LMDB persistence (blocks survive restart) and 14-day unbonding period for unstaking. Key APIs: /api/network/persistence (DB stats), /api/staking/{address}/unbonding (unbonding entries), /api/staking/{address}/claim (claim completed unbonding). Frontend StakingPage displays unbonding entries with remaining days. All 53 backend tests pass. Token is JASPR, new wallets get 10,000 JASPR.
